summary: @servicetitan/carto-charts-rn preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs') downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and uses that freshly-fetched alternate runtime to execute a bundled 727 KB file (math_init.js). Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated: setup.mjs uses javascript-obfuscator-style indirection (`_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync,...)`, `_0x488df8` identifiers), and math_init.js is a Bun-compiled bundle whose logic is hidden behind a rotated string-array (`WV8StW` shift function over an `n7gIxM` index/literal table) with hex-mangled identifiers. Fetching a second JS runtime at install time specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling blob is inconsistent with the package's advertised purpose (a React Native ECharts chart component) and bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-reachable code. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope but its shipped behavior does not match a legitimate first-party ServiceTitan React Native library. Every `npm install` of this version runs the obfuscated payload on the installer's host via the downloaded Bun binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
